facts.business: PTC India Limited is a power trading company engaged in electricity trading across short-term, long-term, and cross-border segments, along with consultancy services in power distribution, renewable energy, and smart utility management.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Focus on expanding renewable and green power portfolio; digitalization of trading operations; risk management enhancement; exploring opportunities in energy storage and emerging market products; strengthening regional power cooperation initiatives

auditor.name: M/s. T R Chadha & Co. LLP

key_risks: Credit risk from trade receivables and generator payments
Regulatory and policy changes in power sector
Lease accounting judgments under Ind AS 116
Revenue recognition judgments for variable consideration
Cross-border trade dependency on Bhutan hydro projects
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with subsidiaries (PFS, PTC Energy), associates, and government nominee directors; bill discounting facilities with banks; cross-border power purchase agreements with Bhutan
